mapped_memories.semantics: Each nonzero-patch start preloads the full selected job into an active register cache using one synchronous SRAM read per cycle. Evaluation is held for patch_capacity + 1 cycles after start (9 for rows, 33 for wide), then resumes the original command-ready evaluator and parallel replay. Zero-patch starts bypass prefetch. Capture handshakes and module ports are unchanged. The original frozen simulation cycles do not describe this synthesis variant.

logic_memory_inventory_scope: Explicit RAM modules and adapted native patch backing SRAM; windows, counts and active-job patch cache remain logic.
semantics: Native FIRRTL SyncReadMem has one-cycle enabled reads and byte masks where present; read-under-write and disabled read output are unspecified. CGRA fullword RAM uses delayed physical writes plus forwarding to preserve one-cycle read-first behavior and output hold. SAED CE positive edge and active-low controls; depth-bank selectors hold without read enable. No storage reset or generated clock.
